fonts.usage: Headings, massive text, buttons. Excellent modern tech display font with strong Cyrillic support.
Body text, UI elements, forms. Clean geometric sans with great Cyrillic readability.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-[1.1]

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: MUST apply heavy `backdrop-blur-xl` or `2xl` and a 1px delicate `border-white/10` on all panels (nav, cards, form). NO fully transparent surfaces behind text.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use soft layered `box-shadow` or `drop-shadow` for neon accents. Do NOT overuse; strongest glow belongs on the primary action button ONLY.
visual_enhancers.background_animation: Continuous moving light streams (CSS/Framer Motion) behind the site. Must be `pointer-events-none` and `z-[-1]`. A dark semi-transparent overlay (`bg-[#05030A]/80`) MUST cover it to ensure readable panels.
visual_enhancers.accessibility_toggles: Provide a Pause button (top right or bottom left) for animations. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` using media queries to render a static, beautiful gradient mesh.

layouts.global: Ensure absolutely NO horizontal scroll by using `overflow-x-hidden` on the main wrapper.
layouts.hero: min-h-screen pt-24 pb-12 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center. Headline/Text spans 7 cols left. Portrait spans 5 cols right.
layouts.services: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Equal spacing, uniform glass cards with denser backgrounds.
layouts.projects: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8. Project thumbnails nested in glass containers.
layouts.enquiry: Max-width wrapper (`max-w-3xl`). Single robust glass panel containing the contact form.

motion.kinetic_hero: Masked line-by-line text reveal on load using Framer Motion (wrap lines in `overflow-hidden`, animate `y` from `100%` to `0`).
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero portrait using `useScroll` and `useTransform` mapping Y scroll to Y translation.
motion.marquee: Slow, smooth editorial marquee running between sections using `react-fast-marquee`.
motion.scroll_reveals: Fade up (`y: 40, opacity: 0` to `y: 0, opacity: 1`) for glass cards with staggered delays.

accessibility.focus: Visible keyboard focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#00E5FF] focus-visible:outline-none`) on all interactive items.
accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA/WCAG standards. Glass backgrounds behind text must be dense enough (`bg-[#0b061c]/85`) to obscure complex neon lines.
accessibility.form: Show success message visually swapping the form ONLY after validated submission. Preserve user input values on error.

components_strategy.navigation: Fixed top glass header, `z-50`. Links: intro, services, projects, enquiry. Must visually separate from background.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary CTA ('Свържи се с мен'): solid gradient fill with drop-shadow glow. Secondary CTA ('Разгледай услугите'): outline glass style.
components_strategy.form_elements: Customized Shadcn inputs. `bg-black/40`, `border-white/10`, white text, focus rings in cyan. Error text in soft red.

image_urls.description: Professional portrait placeholder with dynamic blue/purple neon rim lighting.
Abstract tech/AI glowing lines blue/purple for project thumbnail.
Dark futuristic digital art blue violet neon abstract for project thumbnail.
Abstract data visualization blue purple neon waves for project thumbnail.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page app portfolio (Bulgarian text) using .jsx/.js files (No TypeScript).
Set up continuous animated light streams background spanning the entire site height. Use a dense overlay `bg-[#05030A]/80` on top of the animation so content is readable.
Provide a Pause button to toggle the background animation, and respect prefers-reduced-motion out of the box.
Implement line-by-line kinetic reveal for the Hero headline.
Ensure 'bg-transparent' is NEVER used for panels containing text over the animated background. Use dense glass.
Implement the form with client-side validation. Show success UI only on valid submit.
Apply `data-testid` universally across all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply global `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Do not center align text globally. Keep paragraphs left-aligned.
Avoid standard Shadcn styling without customizing to the 'AI Neon Glass' brand (dark borders, deep blurs).
Use generous padding (p-8, p-12) on cards and sections.
Layer elements properly with z-index to prevent the background animation from blocking clicks.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Always use the precise image URLs provided.
Add 'GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES' principles to every component.
